mapper.select: SELECT id, album_id AS albumId, filename, filepath, uploaded_at AS uploadedAt FROM image WHERE album_id = #{albumId} ORDER BY filename ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO image (id, album_id, filename, filepath, uploaded_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{albumId}, #{filename}, #{filepath}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM image WHERE album_id = #{albumId} AND filename = #{filename}
